name: 承認・変更依頼・却下の操作帯
prompt:
Use case: UI component redesign
Re-render the single approval action toolbar from ORIGINAL image2 as a clean Japanese Lighthouse component LH09-0033. Original images1–2 are the authority for exact icon silhouettes, stroke weights, proportions, alignment, spacing, control order and fine details. Mock3 provides Japanese words only and has wrong substitute glyphs; do not reproduce its heart, club, bent line, repeated arrows or missing request-change icon.
Very wide shallow white strip,666x54 logical pixels, pure white #FFFFFF canvas. Left22px inset and original compact26px high rounded buttons. Three left controls, exact order:
1 Original checkmark +「承認」: primary official135deg gradient #174C36→#1F6444→#2D8F5E, white check/text.
2 Original small amber REQUEST-CHANGES curved return/loop-arrow glyph EXACTLY as source +「変更を依頼」: white button, fine neutral border. Keep original glyph optical weight and geometry; do not substitute headset/undo/text character.
3 Original small red X glyph +「却下」: white button, fine neutral border.
Right aligned in exact original order: thin outlined THUMBS-UP (not heart), thin vertical PAPERCLIP (not club), original connected-node RELATIONSHIP glyph, diagonal interlocking CHAIN LINK, two opposing diagonal EXPAND arrows, horizontal three-dot ellipsis, RIGHT ARROW ending at a vertical BAR to close/collapse the panel. All seven utility icons must be visible and distinct. They are slate #526173, thin source optical strokes, about14px. Preserve original spacing and right inset. No utility labels or extra separators.
Meiryo Regular14/24 Japanese button text, zero tracking. Keep compact readable composition, no all-bold type, no enormous controls. White ordinary surfaces, fine borders, tiny restrained shadow only if needed. No gray/mint panels, random icon colors, extra rows, page shell, watermark, heading, comparison board or perspective. Single flat crisp static toolbar, tight framing.
reviewNotes: 承認・変更を依頼・却下と7つの元ユーティリティアイコンを目視確認。ハートやクラブ等のモック代替記号を使用せず、原本のサムズアップ・クリップ・関係・リンク・拡大・三点・終端バー付き矢印を復元。承認は正式緑、変更／却下は意味ある黄／赤。外側白余白と厳密な原本ベクター・フォント同一性は残差。静的レビューのみ。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
